art_instructions: Inside the same cozy room as the earlier breakfast scene, show the low round wooden table by a sunlit window with cream curtains and a small soft‑green potted plant on the sill. Center the owl (Glaux) at kid eye level, perched on the rim of a shallow woven basket pulled up to the table, wearing her small green scarf; her tiny satchel rests on the wooden floor beside the basket to suggest she just came home. On the tabletop, place a small white ceramic plate with two simple cooked pieces of meat (soft pink‑brown, rounded edges); one piece should be lifted to her beak, with a tiny bite missing and a couple of faint juice/crumb dots to clearly show she is eating. Glaux’s eyes look happy and focused, cheeks slightly blushed, wings tucked close with the head tilted forward as she takes the bite. Keep the background warm and simple: natural wood walls and floor, soft warm daylight from the left window, and a subtle green cushion on the basket seat to echo the home’s green accents. Ensure no bread is present—only the meat on the plate—so the action matches the text. Use the series’ cute aegyo style with clean lines, minimal shading, and an airy, uncluttered room that still fills the frame.
